Module jelena.etfbl.bustraintransport
Package jelena.etfbl.simulation

Class Finder

java.lang.Object
jelena.etfbl.simulation.Finder
public class Finder extends Object
Finder is a route-finding utility class that builds a graph of departures and searches for optimal routes according to given criteria (cheapest, fastest, minimum number of transfers).

Algorithms provided:

  • fastestBytime(Map, String, String, int, Set, Set) â€“ Dijkstra by arrival time (with tie-breaker on number of transfers).
  • cheapest(Map, String, String, int, Set, Set) â€“ Dijkstra by ticket price (primary: price, secondary: arrival time).
  • minTransfers(Map, String, String, int, Set, Set) â€“ BFS by number of transfers (arrival time as secondary criterion within each level).
  • nBestRoutes(Map, String, String, int, int, Criteria) â€“ Yen-style algorithm to find the N the best alternative routes based on a chosen solver.

  • Method Details

    • makeGraph

      public static Map<String,List<Departure>> makeGraph(TransportDataGenerator.TransportData data)
      Builds a directed graph from generated transport data: city -> list of departures. Keys are city names. Departures for each city are sorted by departure time.
      Parameters:
      data - the generated transport data
      Returns:
      a map city â†’ list of departures from that city

    • nBestRoutes

      public static List<Route> nBestRoutes(Map<String,List<Departure>> graph, String departure, String destination, int start, int n, Finder.Criteria criteria) throws IllegalArgumentException
      Returns up to n best routes according to the given criteria. Internally uses a base solver (depending on the criteria) and generates candidates by modifying prefixes of previously found routes (Yen-style approach).
      Parameters:
      graph - the graph of departures (from makeGraph(jelena.etfbl.generate.TransportDataGenerator.TransportData))
      departure - starting city
      destination - destination city
      start - start time (minutes since midnight)
      n - number of routes requested
      criteria - optimization criteria
      Returns:
      a list of routes sorted from best to worst, or an empty list if no route exists
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the criteria is not recognized

    • fastestBytime

      public static Route fastestBytime(Map<String,List<Departure>> graph, String departure, String destination, int startMinutes, Set<Departure> bannedEdges, Set<String> bannedNodes)
      Finds the fastest route (primary: arrival time, secondary: number of transfers, third: ticket price).
      Parameters:
      graph - graph of departures
      departure - start city
      destination - destination city
      startMinutes - start time (minutes since midnight)
      bannedEdges - edges to exclude (used for N-best search)
      bannedNodes - nodes to exclude (used for N-best search)
      Returns:
      the fastest route found, or Route.nullRoute(String, String) if unreachable
